description: Hand-labeled deterministic groundedness cases for yt_rag.groundedness. Each case pairs an answer with the retrieved context texts it should be judged against and the EXPECTED answer-level verdict, labeled by the author per the evaluator's documented rules (coverage >= 0.6 of content words, all numbers present in context, refusal phrases, empty answers). Contexts are excerpts of the committed fixture transcripts (tests/fixtures/teal_chatgpt_linkedin.txt, tests/fixtures/game_dev_ai_paper.txt). These are HEURISTIC labels, NOT semantic truth: the evaluator checks lexical/numeric support, not correctness.
